svg.title: Ending: The War on the God
svg.desc: Ending card, The War on the God: the bark above, the yard below. Above, the bark at night with a victory fire on every ridge and Burr alone, polishing a spear that is no longer clean. Below, a hand held up while another picks a splinter from its fingertip; no face is shown.
svg.text: They won. The Trunk will remember it as long as they do.
